challenge.description: Tunaandaa kila kitu ili uweze kuendelea.
challenge.details.body: Ukaguzi huu mfupi husaidia kuhakikisha tovuti inapatikana kwa kila mtu. Kivinjari chako hufanya hesabu chache ili kuthibitisha ziara hii.
challenge.details.randomx: Ukaguzi unaohitaji uwezo zaidi wa CPU au kumbukumbu, kama RandomX, utaomba ruhusa yako kabla ya kuanza. Unaweza kuondoka kwenye ukurasa huu ikiwa hutaki kuendelea.
challenge.hashwx_unsupported: Kivinjari hiki hakiwezi kuendesha HashWX. Usaidizi wa WebAssembly na Web Workers unahitajika.
challenge.javascript_required: Tafadhali wezesha JavaScript kwenye kivinjari chako, kisha pakia upya ukurasa huu.
challenge.load_error: Ukaguzi haukuweza kuanza. Huenda muunganisho ni wa polepole au faili fulani imezuiwa.
challenge.randomx_unsupported: Kivinjari hiki hakiwezi kuendesha RandomX. Kivinjari kinachotumia WebAssembly, BigInt na Web Workers kinahitajika.
challenge.state.blocked.description: Huenda kiendelezi cha kivinjari au kichujio cha mtandao kimezuia faili inayohitajika na ukaguzi huu. Ruhusu tovuti hii kwenye kiendelezi, kisha ujaribu tena.
challenge.state.blocked.title: Kitu fulani kimezuia ukaguzi
challenge.state.connecting.title: Inaunganisha
challenge.state.consent.description: Ziara hii inahitaji ukaguzi wa kina zaidi kabla ya tovuti kufunguka. Bonyeza Anza ukaguzi ili kuanza.
challenge.state.consent.title: Imebaki hatua moja tu
challenge.state.cookies.description: Tovuti hii hutumia kidakuzi kukumbuka kuwa kivinjari chako kimefaulu ukaguzi. Ruhusu vidakuzi kwa tovuti hii, kisha ujaribu tena.
challenge.state.cookies.title: Vidakuzi vimezuiwa
challenge.state.expired.description: Ukaguzi umechukua muda mrefu kuliko ilivyotarajiwa. Ukaguzi mpya unaweza kusaidia.
challenge.state.expired.title: Hebu tujaribu tena
challenge.state.failed.description: Hatukuweza kukamilisha ukaguzi wakati huu. Jaribio linalofuata linaweza kufanikiwa.
challenge.state.failed.title: Tafadhali jaribu tena
challenge.state.fast.description: Kivinjari chako kinafanya ukaguzi wa haraka. Kwa kawaida, mchakato huu hukamilika kiotomatiki.
challenge.state.fast.title: Tafadhali subiri kidogo
challenge.state.hashwx.description: Kivinjari chako kinafanya ukaguzi wa haraka. Asante kwa subira yako.
challenge.state.hashwx.title: Tafadhali subiri kidogo
challenge.state.initializing.description: Tunaweka mipangilio ya ukaguzi kwenye kivinjari chako.
challenge.state.initializing.title: Tunaandaa
challenge.state.limited.description: Tumepokea maombi mengi. Kusubiri kwa muda mfupi kunaweza kusaidia.
challenge.state.limited.title: Tafadhali jaribu tena baadaye
challenge.state.network.description: Hatukuweza kuwasiliana na huduma ya uthibitishaji. Tafadhali angalia muunganisho wako wa intaneti.
challenge.state.network.title: Muunganisho umekatika
challenge.state.pool.description: Tunasubiri huduma ya uthibitishaji ithibitishe matokeo.
challenge.state.pool.title: Tunakaribia kumaliza
challenge.state.preparing.description: Tunaandaa kila kitu ili uweze kuendelea.
challenge.state.preparing.title: Tafadhali subiri kidogo
challenge.state.randomx.description: Kivinjari chako kinafanya ukaguzi. Weka kichupo hiki wazi hadi ukaguzi ukamilike.
challenge.state.randomx.title: Tunakaribia kumaliza
challenge.state.success.description: Asante kwa subira yako. Sasa unaweza kuendelea.
challenge.state.success.title: Imekamilika!
challenge.state.unavailable.description: Huduma ya uthibitishaji haipatikani kwa sasa. Tafadhali jaribu tena baada ya muda mfupi.
challenge.state.unavailable.title: Kuna ucheleweshaji mfupi
challenge.state.unsupported.description: Kivinjari hiki hakitumii ukaguzi unaohitajika ili kufikia tovuti hii.
challenge.state.unsupported.title: Jaribu kivinjari kingine
challenge.state.verifying.description: Kivinjari chako kimekamilisha ukaguzi. Tunathibitisha matokeo.
challenge.state.verifying.title: Tunakamilisha

denied.title: Ukurasa huu haupatikani
